claim_under_attack.claim_text: Within-corpus scaffold-safe performance (Tg RF LOSO MAE 51.24 K, density RF MAE 0.0566 g/cm3) transfers to out-of-corpus chemistry.

density_verdict.reconciliation: Fire 1 tested leave-one-polymer-class-out on RadonPy PI1070's own 14 internally-assigned class labels (fine-grained, ~77 polymers/class median) and found 1.80x degradation -- below the 2x bar, reported SURVIVED. Fire 2 escalated to hierarchical average-linkage bisection of the full 1077x1077 Tanimoto distance matrix into 2 macro-chemotypes (16 vs 1061 polymers, cut to maximize inter-group dissimilarity) and found 13.74x/7.59x degradation in both directions -- decisively REFUTED. These are not contradictory results on the same test; they are two different severities of out-of-distribution probe. Leave-class-out removes a fine-grained label group whose chemical/density neighborhood remains densely populated by similar polymers from OTHER classes still in the training set, so held-out molecules are not truly outside the training distribution in feature space -- fire 2 additionally confirmed this mechanism directly via a leave-one-Butina-cluster-out probe (0.95x, no measurable degradation, documented as a dead end). Macro-bisection instead removes an entire structurally-coherent region of chemical space (all 16 polymers in the minority macro-chemotype occupy the upper tail of the density range, 1.277-1.914 g/cm3, structurally distinct from the other 1061) so the held-out set is genuinely outside the training distribution -- the closest within-corpus analogue to a real second-corpus swap that RadonPy PI1070 (the module's only rights-cleared density corpus) permits. Under falsification-first principles the strongest attack that was actually capable of finding a violation governs the verdict: a claim of 'transfers to out-of-corpus chemistry' is not rescued by surviving a weaker probe when a harder, methodologically sound probe using the same threshold and same model breaks it. Density transferability is therefore REFUTED, with the leave-class-out result retained as evidence that the degradation is granularity-dependent (visible once the held-out region is structurally coherent, not visible at fine class-label granularity).

tg_verdict.method: True independent second corpus: train RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, seed=0) on OpenPoly experimental Tg (n=443), cold-predict Polyuniverse Epoxy MD-simulated Tg (n=5000 sample), and reverse. Morgan r=2/512-bit fingerprint features.
tg_verdict.why: Both directions blow through the 2x threshold by a wide margin (6.66x, 16.60x) and in both directions the cross-corpus model is WORSE than the trivial predict-the-training-median null baseline (anti-predictive, not merely degraded). Root cause: OpenPoly experimental Tg (median 346.3K) and Polyuniverse Epoxy MD Tg (median 117.8K) occupy non-overlapping numeric ranges; a bagged-tree RF structurally cannot extrapolate past its training-label range. Reproduced verbatim from fire 1's byte-verified diagnostic (sha256 unchanged).
